:::{#lem-exp-neg-log-odds}
#### The exponential of minus the log-odds is one over the odds

Let $A$ be an [event](#def-event) with [probability](#def-probability) $\P(A) \in (0, 1)$,
[odds](#def-odds) $\odds$
and [log-odds](#def-log-odds) $\logodds$.
The [exponential](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-exponentials.html#def-exponential-function) of minus the log-odds of $A$ is one over its odds:

$$\e{-\logodds} = \frac{1}{\odds}.$$

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\e{-\logodds}
&= \e{-\logf{\odds}}
&& \text{(definition of the log-odds)}
\\&= \frac{1}{\e{\logf{\odds}}}
&& \text{(} \e{-x} = 1 / \e{x} \text{)}
\\&= \frac{1}{\odds}
&& \text{(the exponential undoes the natural logarithm)}
\ea
$$

:::
